entities.name: Dromar's Cavern
entities.description: Tomb of the original Vodalians and prison of the dragon Dromar.

entities.name: Dromar
entities.description: Primeval dragon imprisoned in the cavern; guardian of his treasure.

entities.name: Vodalians
entities.description: Merfolk entombed in the cavern, who enchanted undead guards.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: Blue Numena who captured Crosis with a hoard of treasure.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: Red primeval who entered the cavern.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: Green primeval who crushed Dromar's jade and collapsed the ceiling.

entities.name: Treva
entities.description: White primeval who entered the cavern.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion during which the primevals entered the cavern.

entities.name: Fall of the Primevals
entities.description: Event during which Crosis was captured.

events.summary: Lowallyn captured Crosis by luring him to a hoard of treasure.
events.quote: was captured by the blue Numena Lowallyn by luring the dragon to a massive hoard of treasure

events.summary: Rith plucked a jade from Dromar's hoard, waking him, then crushed it and buried the trove.
events.quote: Rith plucked a jade from his horde, which awoke Dromar and his ire.
